title: Add Header and Footer to PDF – Free, No Upload | OpenAnyDoc
description: Add a header and footer to a PDF in your browser, with page numbers, page count and date, in English or Arabic. Free, and nothing is uploaded.
heading: Add a header and footer to a PDF
subtitle: Put text, page numbers and the date at the top and bottom of every page; nothing is uploaded.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file is handled by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: Six places to write
features.text: Start, centre and end of the header and the footer, each with its own text.

features.title: Page numbers and date
features.text: Insert the page number, page count or a date; Western or Arabic-Indic digits.

steps.title: Choose your PDF
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a PDF on the page.

steps.title: Write the header and footer
steps.text: Type into any of the six boxes and insert the page number, page count or date.

steps.title: Pick the look and pages
steps.text: Choose the digits, size and distance from the edge, and the pages. The preview shows the result.

steps.title: Add and download
steps.text: Click Add header and footer, check the preview and download the PDF.

limits: Text is drawn on top of anything already at the top or bottom of the page.
The added text is drawn as a picture, so it can't be selected or searched.
PDFs that need a password to open can't be changed; remove the password first.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: How do I add page numbers like “Page 3 of 10”?
faq.answer: Type Page, click Page number, type of, then click Page count. Each page gets its own numbers.

faq.question: Does start mean left?
faq.answer: On the English page start is the left edge and end the right; on the Arabic page they swap, as Arabic reads from the right.

faq.question: Can the added text be selected or searched?
faq.answer: No. It is drawn as a sharp picture so Arabic letters join and run right to left correctly in every PDF app, which means it can't be selected, copied or searched.

faq.question: Can I use a password-protected PDF?
faq.answer: Not yet. A PDF that needs a password to open can't be read here. Remove the password in the app you use to open it, then try again.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark of ours and no limit on how often you use it.
